pull.title: KAFKA-19818: Move ClientQuotaMetadataManager logic to the metadata module
pull.body:
Migrate `ClientQuotaMetadataManager` from Scala in the `core` module to
Java in the `metadata` module, consolidating its logic into
`DynamicClientQuotaPublisher`.

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

review_comments.body: Could you consolidate this into `DynamicClientQuotaPublisher`? They are handling the same data and we don't need to split them out
Agreed, this fits well in DynamicClientQuotaPublisher. I've updated it.
